result.justification: The research objective is clear, focusing on T-cell epitope prediction using a transformer-based framework. The methodology is explicit, detailing data sources, model architecture, and evaluation metrics.

evidence.quote: In this study, a transformer-based viroinformatics framework is proposed for the prediction of TCEs from Influenza A virus peptide sequences.
Model performance is evaluated using a comprehensive set of binary classification metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall (sensitivity), specificity.
The Transformer architecture leverages self-attention to model interactions between different residue positions within a peptide.
